summary: Mutilate with Seal Fate and Cold Blood, plus Puncturing Wounds from Combat.
rotation: Slice and Dice at 1+ combo points when down; refresh when about to drop
Cold Blood right before a 5-point Eviscerate
Thistle Tea at 10 energy or less; Sapper and potion while Slice and Dice is up
Eviscerate at 4+ combo points (with Slice and Dice up, 79+ energy, or under 6s left); spend leftover points in the last 3s
Vanish into Ambush at 3 combo points or fewer (Shadowmeld into Ambush for a Night Elf)
Mutilate right after a main-hand swing (0.75s)
consumes: Deadly Poison (main hand) and Instant Poison (off hand), each beside a Dense Sharpening Stone
caveats: Backstab with the same talents is the Seal Fate Daggers build, 13 DPS ahead.
Murder does nothing on the generic boss, so its points go to Lethality (Vile Poisons for Seal Fate Daggers).
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks (Backstab VIII, Eviscerate VIII, Deadly Poison IV). They would add 13 to 18.
Assumed: the fight is in Hyjal or the Barrow Deeps. Its flask gives its full bonus only there.
10% hit (the wrist and the second ring carry 10 hit rating each): dual wielders take hit by sim (standards 4), and past the 8% yellow cap it still helps the white hits (+0.4 to +1.9 over 8%).
No Goblin Land Mine: its 1 sec cast resets the swing, so it loses DPS here. The Sapper stays.
notes: Default for the Assassination raid-sim preset.
